description: Example configuration for Smart App Resolution System
instructions: Copy this file to your app's userData directory as 'app-resolver-config.json' and customize as needed

_comments.confidenceThreshold: Minimum confidence (0-1) for automatic launch. Higher = more strict. Default: 0.8
_comments.ambiguousThreshold: Minimum confidence to include in suggestions. Default: 0.5
_comments.maxSuggestions: Maximum number of suggestions to return for ambiguous results. Default: 5
_comments.enabledStrategies: Which resolution strategies to use. Remove strategies you don't need for better performance
_comments.customSearchDirs: Additional directories to search for applications. Add your custom app folders here
_comments.cacheConfig.fuzzyMatchTTL: How long to cache fuzzy search results (milliseconds). Default: 86400000 (24 hours)
_comments.cacheConfig.registryTTL: How long to cache Windows Registry results (milliseconds). Default: 3600000 (1 hour)
_comments.cacheConfig.maxCacheSize: Maximum number of entries in cache. Default: 1000
_comments.searchDirs: Standard directories to search for applications. Environment variables are expanded

fast.description: Optimized for speed - only exact matches

thorough.description: Optimized for finding apps - all strategies enabled

learning-only.description: Rely on learned mappings and registry

portable-apps.description: Configuration for users with portable apps on USB drives

developer.description: Configuration for developers with tools in custom locations

gamer.description: Configuration for gamers with games on multiple drives

minimal.description: Minimal configuration for systems with limited resources
